testcase.name: Scenario: View additional Options commands from a compact panel button: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:200:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: View additional Options commands from a compact panel button ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon displays compact panel buttons ✔ When the user clicks the Options panel button ✔ Then a temporary Options panel opens below the ribbon ✔ And it shows Application Options, Document Settings and Customize ✔ And it also shows Reset UI Layout and iLogic Configuration ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space outside the panel ✔ Then the temporary Options panel closes ✔ And the compact Tools panel buttons remain visible
